summary: Your conveyancing and leasing page has named lawyers and clear contact details, but an outdated message, an unfinished form and little proof hold it back.

findings.problem: The Online Enquiry form has fields and a disclaimer but no visible submit button, and the only other action is Contact us.
findings.cost: A client who fills the form may not be able to send it.
findings.fix: A working form with a clear send button.

findings.problem: The page says From 1 July 2019 documents will need to be lodged electronically and From 1 July 2020 many more to come, as if those dates were ahead.
findings.cost: Out of date wording signals a site no one maintains.

findings.problem: Typos and slips include NEWs, New South Wales.From, PEXA and OSR with no explanation, and answer options that run together (YesNo).
findings.cost: Errors and jargon confuse clients and lower trust.

findings.problem: Testimonials appear only as a menu link, there is no WhatsApp or booking option, and Primary Sidebar and Footer labels show on the page.
findings.cost: Clients want proof and an easy way to book.
findings.fix: Testimonials on the page, WhatsApp and a booking link.

redesign: A working enquiry form, click to call and a booking link.
Current guidance, testimonials on the page and lawyer profiles.
